source.name: Shiller Irrational Exuberance Dataset
source.author: Robert J. Shiller
source.format: CSV (converted from XLS; European decimal commas: comma as decimal separator, period as thousands)
source.description: Monthly stock price, dividends, earnings, CPI, CAPE (P/E10), TR CAPE, real returns since 1871

acquisition.vintage: unknown — this is a 2026 snapshot, not confirmed as the 2016-era version ERN used

content.notes: No October observations exist across the entire date range. This is a source-level property of the Shiller dataset, not an FBF ingestion error.

relationships.to_ern_real_returns_1871_2016.csv: Derived: columns 9 (real total return price) and 6 (10-year Treasury) were extracted and converted to monthly real returns
relationships.to_ern_cape_1871_2016.json: Should be derived from column 12 (CAPE/P/E10) — but existing FBF CAPE file has 142 unexplained January mismatches
relationships.to_ern_swr_h720.json: Indirect: real returns from this source were used to build the SWR simulation dataset with forward projections

historical_vintage_note: This file was acquired in September 2026. The Shiller dataset is periodically updated and revised. The exact version ERN used in December 2016 cannot be confirmed from available evidence. The 2016 Wayback Machine copy of the Shiller XLS has identical January CAPE values to this 2026 snapshot, confirming that Shiller has not revised historical January CAPE between 2016 and 2026. However, the existing FBF CAPE file (ern_cape_1871_2016.json) has 142 January values that differ from BOTH the 2016 and 2026 Shiller snapshots, indicating the FBF CAPE file was not derived from either version.
